body:
GREG DIRECT, 2026-11-02 ~23:22Z, said to Engram::Asistant (session-15908), relayed to Engram::Fable via mailbox 43498a6e #71. It came after TermAl's w-3fe8 C4 full gate (test-6580d0ce) passed every test (6800/0 Rust, all other stages green) and was red only because 2 tests left temporary directories behind. Verbatim: „Nie. To sa drobne rzeczy.
Naprawimy pozniej.
Skonczmy failowac drogie testy przez glupoty!!!!!"

Application:
(1) For that C4: the expensive FULL is not rerun only for the leftovers. The cleanup is filed as TermAl w-6bb54cae56aa (P2), there is no C5, and the commit Greg authorized continues. The commit still needs Greg's own word in the acting session (Termal::Opus2), because it lands outside the standing approval.
(2) General direction: an expensive gate must not fail on trivia such as cleanup leftovers when every real check passed; such conditions are reported and filed. TermAl tracks it as w-153c5134c60e (P1, greg-directed); there the failure was the run-root cleanup guard in scripts/test-rust.sh.
Engram's launcher already reports new-untracked-only (scripts/test-launcher.mjs:830–849), which the integration owner may count as a pass under the standing approval's gate clause.
Any change to either gate's semantics or wording goes through the normal item, review and authority-file procedure, not ad hoc. Source: Greg's words above.
